page.layout: One printed title page on a full-page orange cover: a large title block in capitals centred at top, a rule, and a smaller subtitle block centred below. A Google digitiser logo at bottom right is left out.
page.notes: The page is a modern digitised cover, not a 16th–17th century title page. The decorative background of yellow geometric line patterns is not printed text. The "Digitized by Google" logo is left out as a digitiser's mark. The title is in white sans-serif capitals on orange; the accent on "José" is as shown on the cover.
